member.name: M:GarageManagement.Web.BAL.UserBAL.VerifyLogin(System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Verifies credentials against tblUsers. Returns the matched User (with PasswordHash/Salt cleared) on success, or null on any failure — unknown username, wrong password, and inactive account all return the same null result so login pages can't distinguish "wrong password" from "unknown user" (avoids username enumeration).
